subsystems.name: Radios
subsystems.role: connect the hub to the home network and to low-power devices.

subsystems.name: Compute and storage
subsystems.role: runs the software that coordinates devices and stores automation rules.

subsystems.name: Matter stack
subsystems.role: speaks the common application-layer language so devices from different brands interoperate.

subsystems.name: Thread border router
subsystems.role: bridges the low-power Thread mesh to the home IP network.

subsystems.name: Automation engine
subsystems.role: runs schedules, scenes and rules locally so they work without the internet.

subsystems.name: Remote access bridge
subsystems.role: optional; allows control when away and links to voice assistants.

buildSteps.title: Design the hardware
buildSteps.detail: Choose a system-on-chip with Wi-Fi, Thread and Bluetooth radios, lay out the board and antennas, and design the enclosure.

buildSteps.title: Port the Matter stack
buildSteps.detail: Implement the Matter controller and commissioner so the hub can discover, pair and command certified devices.

buildSteps.title: Integrate the Thread border router
buildSteps.detail: Add the Thread stack and border router service so low-power devices on the mesh can be reached over IPv6.

buildSteps.title: Build the local automation engine
buildSteps.detail: Write the rules engine, scheduler and scene handling so automations keep running when the internet is down.

buildSteps.title: Implement commissioning
buildSteps.detail: Add Bluetooth Low Energy setup, QR-code scanning and Matter pairing to bring new devices onto the network securely.

buildSteps.title: Certify the product
buildSteps.detail: Pass Matter certification, Thread certification, and regional radio and safety approvals.

buildSteps.title: Manufacture and test
buildSteps.detail: Assemble boards, run functional tests and provision unique credentials for each unit.

buildSteps.title: Ship software updates
buildSteps.detail: Deploy over-the-air updates for security patches and new Matter device types.

pathway.milestone: Matter 1.x hubs with Thread border routers are common
pathway.unlocks: cross-brand control and local automation without an app per device.

pathway.milestone: Matter adds more device types such as energy, water and appliance devices
pathway.unlocks: whole-home energy management and richer automations.

pathway.milestone: Thread and border router improvements for larger, more reliable meshes
pathway.unlocks: robust coverage across large homes and multiple floors.

pathway.milestone: on-device AI for automation and anomaly detection
pathway.unlocks: privacy-preserving, adaptive smart homes that learn routines locally.
